regulatory_or_exposure.what: Food safety limit for Pb used by the authors (stated as e.g. 0.25 mg/kg)

unresolved: Two descriptive tables (Table 2 in Methods, Table 4 in Results) give different Pb statistics for the same samples; both recorded with integrity flags.
Methods exclude factory-packaged items, yet Table 3 lists 4 'packaged light snacks'.
Results are not reported per food type.
Sampling dates, digestion method, detection limits and reference-material results are not reported.
Inside-terminal exceedances: 2 of 15 above 0.25 mg/kg, while Table 2 prints an inside maximum of 0.25 mg/kg.
